content.intro: Heart failure is a condition where the heart cannot pump enough blood to meet the body's needs. It often develops over time due to conditions like high blood pressure, coronary artery disease, or previous heart attacks that weaken the heart muscle. At OMNI Hospitals, our expert heart failure doctors provide advanced diagnosis, effective congestive heart failure treatment, and long-term management plans for patients with chronic or acute heart failure, including chronic diastolic heart failure.

sections.description: Heart failure may result from several heart and systemic conditions:

subsections.description: Narrowed or blocked arteries reduce blood supply to the heart.
Structural issues present from birth.
Damage from a past attack can impair heart function.
Weakened heart muscles due to infections, alcohol, genetics, or drug abuse.
Hypertension, diabetes, kidney disease, thyroid disorders, and valve disease.

sections.h2: Congestive Heart Failure Symptoms to Watch For
sections.description: Early recognition of heart failure symptoms is essential for timely treatment. Key signs include:
list: Shortness of breath (during activity or at rest)
Fatigue and weakness
Swelling in feet or ankles (pedal edema)
Nocturnal coughing or breathing difficulty (PND)
Frequent urination at night
Chest pain or pressure
Loss of appetite, indigestion
Dizziness or giddiness
Persistent dry cough

sections.h2: Diagnosis of Heart Failure at OMNI Hospitals
sections.description: Our heart failure doctors in Hyderabad use a combination of clinical evaluation and advanced diagnostics:

subsections.description: Assesses heart pumping, valve function, and chamber size
Identifies rhythm abnormalities or heart attack history
Checks for heart enlargement and fluid in the lungs
Indicates the presence and severity of heart failure
CT scan, MRI, coronary angiogram, stress tests, or myocardial biopsy if needed

sections.h2: Heart Failure Treatment Options in Hyderabad
sections.description: OMNI Hospitals offers personalized heart failure treatment based on severity and patient needs:

list: Weight management, salt and fluid restriction
Cardiac rehabilitation and low-impact exercise
Complete avoidance of smoking, alcohol, and substance abuse
Diuretics to prevent fluid retention
ACE inhibitors, beta-blockers, and other heart medications to improve heart function
Bypass surgery, valve repair, or replacement
Heart transplant in end-stage heart failure
ICDs (Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillators): Correct dangerous arrhythmias
CRT (Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy): Synchronizes heartbeats and improves pump function

sections.h2: Accurate Diagnosis of Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) at OMNI Hospitals
sections.description: A Coronary Angiogram, also called Cardiac Catheterization, is a specialized diagnostic procedure used to detect blockages in the coronary arteries. This test helps identify Coronary Artery Disease (CAD), a condition where cholesterol, plaque, or fat deposits restrict blood flow to the heart, potentially leading to a heart attack. OMNI Hospitals is the best hospital for angiogram in Hyderabad, providing accurate diagnosis and expert cardiac care from the city's top angiogram specialists.

During the procedure, a thin, flexible tube called a catheter is inserted into a blood vessel, usually through the wrist or groin. A contrast dye (safe for medical use) is injected into the coronary arteries. As the dye flows through the heart's arteries, it becomes visible under real-time X-ray imaging (fluoroscopy).
sections.conclusion: The resulting images, known as an angiogram, allow cardiologists to identify the location and severity of blockages, a crucial step before treatments such as angioplasty or stent placement.

sections.h2: When Is a Coronary Angiogram Recommended?
list: Chest pain or angina (tightness, pressure, or burning sensation)
Abnormal ECG, stress test, or echocardiogram results
Unexplained pain in the jaw, neck, shoulder or arm
Suspected coronary artery disease (CAD)
Congenital heart defects (CHDs)
History of chest trauma or heart injury
Preoperative cardiac evaluation before surgery

sections.description: A coronary angiogram typically takes between 30 minutes to 1 hour. If angioplasty or stent placement is performed in the same session, the duration may extend depending on the patient's condition.

After the procedure, patients are observed for a few hours to ensure stable recovery. Most individuals can return home the same day or within 24 hours. Follow-up visits help review the angiogram results and plan further treatment if needed.

list: Following a heart-healthy lifestyle
Avoiding smoking, alcohol, and tobacco

Regular exercise as recommended by the cardiologist

content.intro: Coronary Angioplasty, also known as Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI), is a minimally invasive cardiac procedure used to open blocked or narrowed arteries and restore normal blood flow to the heart. This treatment helps prevent serious complications like heart attacks and improves heart function. OMNI Hospitals is the best hospital for angioplasty in Hyderabad. Our expert cardiologists specialize in both conventional and laser angioplasty techniques to ensure safe, effective, and lasting results.

sections.description: Angioplasty in Hyderabad is usually recommended for individuals experiencing:
list: Acute myocardial infarction (heart attack)
Severe chest pain (angina)
Coronary artery blockages (atherosclerosis)
Abnormal stress test or angiogram results
Reduced blood supply to the heart muscle
Physician recommendation based on cardiac risk profile

sections.description: The procedure begins after diagnostic imaging, such as a coronary angiogram, confirms the presence of arterial blockages.
sections.conclusion: Under local anesthesia, a catheter is inserted through the groin or wrist and guided to the affected artery. A small balloon at the catheter tip is inflated to compress the plaque against the arterial wall, improving blood flow. In most cases, a drug-eluting stent (DES) is placed to keep the artery open long-term. OMNI Hospitals also offers laser angioplasty in Hyderabad, a cutting-edge method that uses laser energy to remove plaque buildup and restore artery patency with precision.

subsections.description: Depending on the number and location of blockages, angioplasty surgery may take 30 minutes to a few hours. If multiple arteries are involved, your cardiologist may perform the procedures in separate sessions for safety.

sections.description: After the procedure, our cardiac team ensures personalized follow-up and rehabilitation. Patients are advised to:
list: Follow a heart-healthy diet and lifestyle
Quit smoking, alcohol, and tobacco
Manage cholesterol (LDL/HDL) and blood pressure levels
Participate in a doctor-guided cardiac rehab or exercise program

subsections.description: Return to work within 5–7 days
Recovery may take a few weeks to months, depending on overall health and heart function

content.h1: Permanent Cardiac Pacemaker Implantation in Hyderabad
content.intro: At OMNI Hospitals, we specialize in Permanent Pacemaker Implantation (PPI), a life-saving procedure for patients suffering from bradycardia (slow heart rate) or irregular heart rhythms such as ventricular dyssynchrony. Our expert cardiologists provide advanced, safe, and effective pacemaker treatment in Hyderabad, ensuring every patient receives personalized cardiac care with modern technology.

sections.description: A permanent pacemaker is a small, battery-powered electronic device implanted under the collarbone. It helps maintain a steady heart rhythm by sending tiny electrical impulses to the heart whenever it beats too slowly or irregularly.
The device consists of:

subsections.description: Contains the battery and electrical circuit.
Placed in specific heart chambers to deliver electrical signals.

sections.conclusion: The pacemaker continuously monitors the heart's rhythm. When it detects an abnormal heartbeat, it sends signals to correct it, ensuring smooth blood circulation and stable heart function.

subsections.description: Sends signals to one heart chamber (usually the right atrium or ventricle).
Coordinates activity between the atrium and ventricle for a more natural rhythm.
Used in heart failure patients to improve pumping efficiency and overall heart performance.
